fix_summary.title: Fix TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory
fix_summary.description: Fixed race condition (TOCTOU) in _ensure_parent_directory by replacing check-then-create pattern with atomic try/except pattern using exist_ok=True
fix_summary.approach: Replace non-atomic `if not parent.exists(): parent.mkdir(exist_ok=False)` with atomic `parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)` wrapped in try/except to handle race conditions

risks.description: Low risk. The fix maintains the same error handling behavior while eliminating the race condition window. The exist_ok=True flag is the recommended pattern for this use case.

limitations.description: The fix addresses the TOCTOU between exists() and mkdir(), but the parent component check loop (lines 35-40) still has a minor TOCTOU window between exists() and is_dir() for symlink attacks. This is a lower severity issue and would require more complex handling.
